evidence.quote: Gesetz über Urheberrecht und verwandte Schutzrechte (Urheberrechtsgesetz)

summary.short: Section 44b of Germany's Copyright Act defines text and data mining and permits reproductions of lawfully accessible works for that purpose, to be deleted once no longer needed. Uses are excluded where rights holders have reserved them; online reservations count only if machine-readable.
summary.long: This document is § 44b of the German Copyright Act (Urheberrechtsgesetz), a partial text covering only that section. Paragraph 1 defines text and data mining (TDM) as the automated analysis of one or more digital or digitised works to obtain information, in particular about patterns, trends and correlations. Paragraph 2 permits reproductions of lawfully accessible works for TDM and requires that they be deleted once they are no longer necessary for that purpose. Paragraph 3 makes these uses permitted only where the rights holder has not reserved them; for works accessible online, a reservation is effective only if made in machine-readable form. The section does not name a specific addressee role, sets no thresholds, penalties or dates, and does not mention artificial intelligence.

notes: Excerpt: this annotation covers only § 44b paras 1-3 of the UrhG. The section cites no other instrument, names no authority, and contains no enforcement or penalty provisions. Para. 3 sentence 2 states that a reservation of use for online-accessible works is effective only if made in machine-readable form. Other sections of the Gesetz are not covered here.

evidence.quote: Text und Data Mining ist die automatisierte Analyse von einzelnen oder mehreren digitalen oder digitalisierten Werken, um daraus Informationen insbesondere über Muster, Trends und Korrelationen zu gewinnen.

obligations.summary: Reproductions of lawfully accessible works may be made for text and data mining (permission; the text names no specific addressee).

evidence.quote: Zulässig sind Vervielfältigungen von rechtmäßig zugänglichen Werken für das Text und Data Mining.

obligations.summary: Reproductions made for text and data mining must be deleted once they are no longer necessary for that purpose.
obligations.conditional_on: Reproductions are no longer necessary for text and data mining.

evidence.quote: Die Vervielfältigungen sind zu löschen, wenn sie für das Text und Data Mining nicht mehr erforderlich sind.

obligations.summary: Uses under the text and data mining permission are not permitted where the rights holder has reserved them.
obligations.conditional_on: The rights holder has not reserved the use.

evidence.quote: Nutzungen nach Absatz 2 Satz 1 sind nur zulässig, wenn der Rechtsinhaber sich diese nicht vorbehalten hat.

obligations.summary: A rights holder's reservation of use for online-accessible works is effective only if made in machine-readable form.
obligations.conditional_on: The work is online-accessible and the rights holder reserves use.

evidence.quote: Ein Nutzungsvorbehalt bei online zugänglichen Werken ist nur dann wirksam, wenn er in maschinenlesbarer Form erfolgt.
